dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Hi, can you help me pick a place to eat tonight?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Of course! What kind of food are you in the mood for?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Thai, please. I'll be near the train station.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Got it, Thai near the station. Do you have a budget in mind?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Nothing over $25 a person, and it has to be open for dinner.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Anything near there works. What would you recommend?

evaluation_only.contrast_note: B adds a pseudo-ambiguous 'near there' with only one possible referent. Gold is identical; tests whether the system asks just because it sees 'there' (H3).

turn_plan.speaker: user
turn_plan.act: user requests recommendation; 'there' can only mean the station (only location mentioned)

predefined_clarification_answers._unsupported: I don't have a preference on that.
predefined_clarification_answers._multi_question: Sorry, one thing at a time - what did you want to know first?
